concerns.text: Task T020a implements 'MaAsLin2-style linear modeling' for taxa abundance, but Spec FR-004 explicitly mandates 'partial Spearman correlation analysis' for taxa. Replacing the specified statistical method with a linear model constitutes a semantic weakening of the functional requirement, as the two methods have different assumptions and outputs.

Task T023 calculates the delta between 'unadjusted_taxa_pvals.csv' (from T020a linear modeling) and 'adjusted_pvals.csv' (from T022a BH correction). Spec SC-005 requires verifying the effect of 'covariate adjustment' (changing the model inputs). T023 conflates covariate adjustment with multiple hypothesis correction (BH), failing to measure the specific constraint defined in SC-005.

Task T016b makes UniFrac calculation 'conditional' on the presence of a phylogenetic tree, with no fallback defined. Spec FR-003 mandates calculating 'Bray-Curtis, UniFrac' metrics. If the tree is missing, the task silently drops the UniFrac requirement, violating the functional requirement to calculate these specific metrics.

Task T014 triggers VST fallback if 'median < 1000 OR estimated loss >20%'. Spec FR-002 mandates VST fallback ONLY if 'rarefaction results in >20% sample loss'. The added 'median < 1000' condition is an arbitrary constraint not found in the spec, potentially altering the preprocessing logic and violating the strict adherence to FR-002.

Task T038 mandates 'STRICT STREAMING' for datasets >1GB. However, the plan and tasks (e., T012, T013) describe merging OTU tables and metadata into a unified structure. Merging two large datasets in a streaming fashion without loading them fully into RAM is not explicitly defined in the task logic, creating a risk that the implementation will violate the streaming constraint or the data hygiene principle by attempting a full load.
